name: librejustice
description: The LibreJustice MCP connector and its skills: free French legal research, case law from France's administrative and judicial courts, and legislation as it stood on any date.

plugins.name: librejustice
plugins.description: Free and open source, LibreJustice gives your agent ~3.7 million French and European decisions and ~3.6 million legal articles as they stood on any date: five MCP tools over OAuth, no API key, and two research skills.
